notes: One literal variable: CU sets COLI_CUDA_MOE_BATCH=0, GB keeps COMMON_ENV's 1, and neither sets DSV4_CUDA_VRAM_RESERVE_MB. The switch also changes the default mirror reserve (600 -> 3100 MiB), and the f42-vram-reserve-* records attribute about 88% of this gap to that reserve: GR (bank prefill, 600 MiB reserve) is within 0.4% of CU on this text. The long_200 record for this variable is not written: the two prefill paths give different long_200 texts from the first token on.

DSV4_CUDA_VRAM_RESERVE_MB is the free VRAM the decode mirror cache leaves on GPU0 while it grows. Unset with COLI_CUDA_MOE_BATCH=1, it is the bank-sized default (3100 MiB = 600 headroom + 1683 MiB 132-slot bank + 64 mirrors), so the next long prefill finds its bank. At 600 the cache took 2236 MiB more (VRAM plateau 23558 vs 21322 MiB, about 1271 vs 1096 mirrors of 12.75 MiB). Decode then uploads fewer experts. Not measured here: the cost on a later long prefill, which would have to find bank VRAM the mirrors hold. short_200 is below COLI_CUDA_MOE_BATCH_MIN and never takes the bank.
